- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 3–5% buffer to avoid early drop.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast 3–5 days post-spike at 10–15% below peak.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show rising prices, reduce forecast slope by 10–15%.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in the cycle — adjust downward by 2–4% for first 7–10 days.
- Sentiment reversal triggers: if sentiment drops sharply after peak, reduce forecast by 5–8% for next 5 days.
